_comment: TubeHunter classification catalog — generated by build_catalog.py. Any alias found on the store page (name split on / space) that matches a key here inherits its record. An entry may declare `alias_of: X` plus overrides.

_categories.pentode_pre: Small-signal pentode preamp (audio or RF, not power)
_categories.combo: Triode-pentode combo (preamp triode + SE power pentode in one envelope)

_fields.cutoff: sharp | remote — pentodes only; remote-cutoff distorts audio
_fields.vibe: guitar-amp heritage: 0 none · 1 known · 2 classic · 3 holy grail
_fields.elements: list of what's inside the envelope, e.g. ['triode','power_pentode']
_fields.alias_of: inherit from another entry, override any listed field
_fields.notes: 1-sentence description shown in the detail drawer

0Z4.notes: Cold-cathode full-wave rectifier — no heater, gas-discharge.

117N7.notes: 117V-heater rectifier+beam tetrode. Ancient AC/DC set service.

12A7.notes: 12V beam power + half-wave rectifier in one octal envelope.

12AB5.notes: 12V beam power — 9-pin. Half of a 12V push-pull car radio.

12AC6.notes: Remote-cutoff 12V pentode — not for audio front.

12AD7.notes: Low-noise 12AX7 with alt-pinout — used in some vintage tape/preamps.

12AE10.notes: Compactron triode + beam power. Won't fit.

12AT7.notes: ECC81. Bright, medium-gain dual triode. Classic PI in Fender/Marshall.

12AU6.notes: 12V-heater 6AU6 — same sharp-cutoff pentode, different heater rail. Works fine on Voxy's buck-boost.

12AU7.notes: ECC82. Low-µ, low-Z. Great cathodyne PI, buffer, driver.

12AV7.notes: Dual triode, medium-µ. Used in early Fender PI slots and Ampeg builds.

12AX7.notes: ECC83 — THE guitar preamp triode. High µ, low noise, cheap and plentiful.

12AY7.notes: Tweed Fender low-noise favorite. Warm, less gain than 12AX7.

12AZ7.notes: Ruggedized twin triode — like a beefier 12AT7.

12B4.notes: Low-µ noval single triode — great cathode follower / driver.

12BH7.notes: Big brother of 12AU7 — more current, great driver/PI.

12BY7.notes: High-gm video output pentode (9-pin) — sometimes used as boutique preamp.

12DW7.notes: Dissimilar dual triode: one section 12AX7-like (mu=100), other 12AU7-like (mu=17). Common in reverb drive circuits.

1B3.notes: TV HV rectifier — 25kV kind of thing.

1S2.notes: Half-wave HV rectifier for battery-TV service.

2-01C.notes: Old European ballast / regulator resistor tube.

2D21.notes: Small thyratron — grid-controlled gas discharge, industrial.

2X2.notes: HV half-wave rectifier — old radio service.

300B.notes: Directly-heated triode — SE audiophile darling. UX4 base, 5V heater.

502.notes: Obscure old designation — likely a receiving valve; consult datasheet.

502 Tube.notes: Obscure — likely a display / indicator tube; consult datasheet.

5670.notes: Compact 9-pin dual triode, low-noise. Popular in boutique preamps (Cornetta).

5687.notes: High-current low-µ twin triode (Tung-Sol / WE). Boutique cathode-follower and driver.

5751.notes: Lower-gain ruggedized 12AX7 sub. Warmer, more headroom.

5763.notes: Transmitting beam pentode, 9-pin — used in QRP tx and boutique preamps.

5842.notes: Very high-gm single triode — WE 417A. Cathode follower / boutique preamp.

5Y3.notes: Full-wave octal rectifier — sag. Fender tweed staple.

6-4 Ballast.notes: Ballast tube — inrush limiter for tube sets, not a valve.

6012.notes: Subminiature diode — used in guided-missile electronics.

6021.notes: Subminiature twin triode — used in hearing aids.

6080.notes: Big dual low-µ triode — series regulator, also hi-fi OTL. Octal.

6111.notes: Subminiature 7-lead dual triode — hearing-aid / boutique preamp.

6146.notes: Transmitting beam tetrode — top-cap plate. Sometimes used in guitar amps (Ampeg).

6336.notes: Big low-µ dual triode for series-pass regulators and OTL hi-fi.

6350.notes: Premium industrial dual triode — computer service.

6A6.notes: Very early dual triode (UX7 base — 7-pin large).

6AC10.notes: Compactron triple triode — TV service, won't fit 7/9-pin chassis.

6AG5.notes: Sharp-cutoff RF pentode. Works as small preamp.

6AG7.notes: Octal beam power (audio output) — early hi-fi.

6AH6.notes: High-gm sharp-cutoff pentode. Push it and you get gain.

6AL5.notes: Twin small-signal diode — detector / limiter, not damper. 9-pin, fits chassis but not really useful in Voxy.

6AN8.notes: Triode + pentode — small combo (not a power tube).

6AQ7.notes: Noval version of 6SQ7 — duo-diode + high-µ triode.

6AS6.notes: Small sharp-cutoff video pentode with suppressor grid brought to pin.

6AS7.notes: Dual low-µ power triode — big series-pass regulator tube. Not a normal audio slot.

6AT6.notes: Duo-diode + high-µ triode — AM radio second detector + audio.

6AU6.notes: Sharp-cutoff pentode, 7-pin B7G. Voxy's V1. EF94 equivalent, widely used in RF/IF and audio preamps.

6AV6.notes: Duo-diode + high-µ triode. Half of a 12AX7.

6AW6.notes: Noval sharp-cutoff video pentode, high gm.

6AX7.notes: Parallel-heater 12AX7 for 6.3V-only chassis. Same tube inside.

6BA6.notes: Remote-cutoff RF/IF pentode. Distorts as audio — avoid for preamp.

6BE6.notes: Pentagrid converter for AM radios. Not audio.

6BF5.notes: Small beam power tube — 7-pin. Similar to 6AQ5.

6BG6.notes: 6L6 with top-cap plate. TV horizontal-out for military amps.

6BL7.notes: Octal dual triode power — vertical output. SE hi-fi.

6BM5.notes: Small 9-pin audio output pentode. Around 3W SE.

6BR7.notes: Low-noise noval audio pentode — EF86 sibling.

6BX6.notes: US 6-pin base for EF80 — actually noval, sharp-cutoff.

6BX7.notes: Octal dual triode power — vertical output.

6C4.notes: Single triode — half of a 12AU7. 7-pin B7G.

6C6.notes: UX6 base — early sharp-cutoff pentode. Won't fit modern chassis.

6CL6.notes: Very high-gm noval video/audio pentode — boutique preamp.

6CM7.notes: Dissimilar dual triode — half like 12AX7, half like 12AU7. Fender reverb driver.

6CS7.notes: Dissimilar dual triode power — SE hi-fi.

6CW4.notes: Nuvistor — thimble-sized metal-cased triode. Won't fit standard socket.

6DE6.notes: Remote-cutoff video pentode — avoid audio front end.

6DE7.notes: Dual dissimilar triode — one section is a small power triode. SE ~2W. Small hi-fi builds.

6DJ8.notes: ECC88 low-Va cathode-follower / hi-fi triode. Cool blue-glow. Grid-current at higher Va.

6EA7.notes: Dual dissimilar triode power — SE ~1.5W each half.

6EA8.notes: Small triode + medium pentode. Not a power tube.

6EM7.notes: Dual dissimilar triode power — small SE. Also driver+PA in one envelope.

6EQ7.notes: Dual triode — remote cutoff for TV service.

6ES8.notes: ECC189 remote-cutoff dual triode — variable-µ, not for clean audio.

6EW7.notes: Dual dissimilar triode — small SE output.

6F5.notes: Octal high-µ single triode. Won't fit chassis.

6F6.notes: Octal small power pentode — pre-6V6. Won't fit chassis.

6GE5.notes: 9-pin noval sweep pentode — technically fits chassis!

6GK6.notes: EL84 in 9-pin noval — SE-hifi power pentode.

6GX7.notes: Dual dissimilar triode power — SE hi-fi.

6H30Pi.notes: Russian 'super triode' — high current, low Rp. Popular in hi-fi.

6HA5.notes: High-gm noval triode (not a combo, n=1).

6HS8.notes: Twin power pentode — 9-pin dual EL84-ish. Rare.

6HU8.notes: Twin small power pentode — 9-pin PP output in one envelope.

6J5.notes: Half of a 6SN7 — single octal triode.

6J6.notes: 7-pin dual triode — VHF. Boutique preamp curiosity.

6JS6.notes: Big TV HO / audio if you're brave.

6K6.notes: Octal small beam power. Won't fit.

6K8.notes: Octal triode-hexode converter for AM sets.

6KH8.notes: Twin power pentode — 9-pin dual output for PP amp.

6L6.notes: Big Fender/Marshall beam tetrode. Octal — Voxy chassis is too small.

6LF6.notes: Very big duodecar sweep — high-power sweep tube.

6N1P.notes: Russian dual triode ECC88-ish, high current. Common tone-stack driver.

6N6.notes: Octal class-B dual triode (audio driver output).

6N6P.notes: Russian dual triode — high current, µ~20. Great driver.

6NO30T.notes: Obscure — likely Russian designation; consult datasheet.

6Q7.notes: Non-single-ended pinout of 6SQ7 — duo-diode + high-µ triode.

6S4.notes: 9-pin single power triode — TV vertical driver, also boutique SE.

6SC7.notes: High-µ dual triode, shared cathode. Octal.

6SJ7.notes: Classic Gibson/Valco preamp pentode — octal, won't fit Voxy chassis.

6SL7.notes: High-µ octal dual triode. Won't fit 9-pin chassis.

6SN7.notes: Classic octal dual triode. Won't fit 9-pin chassis.

6SQ7.notes: Duo-diode + high-µ triode. AM radio audio.

6SR7.notes: Duo-diode + triode octal — old AM radio detector-preamp.

6V6.notes: Fender tweed staple — beam power, octal. Won't fit Voxy 9-pin chassis.

6X4.notes: B7G 7-pin small rectifier — usable in 7-pin chassis.

7027.notes: Ampeg 6L6 sibling — same envelope, different pinout.

7189.notes: Ruggedized industrial EL84 (7189A rated to 400V plate).

7199.notes: Triode + pentode — Dyna Stereo 70 driver/PI. Sought-after.

7586.notes: Nuvistor — metal-cased thimble triode. Won't fit standard socket.

7591.notes: Ampeg / Fisher / Scott beam power tube. Octal.

7722.notes: Siemens D3a — legendary audiophile industrial pentode.

7788.notes: Siemens E810F — ultra-high-gm frame-grid pentode. Boutique.

801A.notes: Transmitting DHT triode — used in SE hi-fi.

807.notes: Transmitting beam — top-cap plate. Some vintage Vox and Marshall.

8233.notes: Siemens E55L — ultra-high-gm audio pentode. Boutique legend.

C3M.notes: Siemens telephone pentode — audiophile darling. Octal.

E180F.notes: Alt name for E280F Siemens pentode.

E80F.notes: Philips industrial low-noise pentode — hi-fi phono.

ECC85.notes: Dual triode, FM tuner front-end. Also usable as preamp.

ECC86.notes: Low-Va dual triode (car radio) — under 30V plate rating.

ECF80.notes: Triode + small-signal pentode (not a power tube).

ECH81.notes: Triode + heptode converter for AM/FM radios.

ECL85.notes: High-power combo — TV line output triode+pentode.

ECL86.notes: 6.3V version of PCL86 — high-µ triode + ~4W SE pentode.

EF183.notes: Remote-cutoff RF pentode. Distorts as an audio preamp — avoid.

EF184.notes: Very high-gm frame-grid pentode — hi-fi phono preamp / video IF. Can be pushed hard as boutique preamp.

EF37.notes: Non-A EF37 — Mullard octal audio pentode.

EF37A.notes: Mullard octal audio pentode — refined, EF86 family. Won't fit 7/9-pin chassis.

EF40.notes: Loctal predecessor to EF86 — same low-noise family.

EF80.notes: European sharp-cutoff pentode, TV video amp. High gm — usable as guitar preamp with reduced screen.

EF85.notes: Variable-µ RF/IF pentode — remote-cutoff, distorts audio.

EF86.notes: Low-noise sharp-cutoff pentode. THE Vox AC15/AC30 top-boost preamp — the pentode-preamp holy grail.

EF89.notes: Remote-cutoff IF pentode. Not for audio front ends.

EF91.notes: Mullard TV IF pentode — sharp-cutoff, high gm.

EF95.notes: Sub-miniature-style HF pentode — usable low-noise preamp.

EL34.notes: Marshall pentode. Octal — won't fit Voxy chassis.

EL41.notes: Loctal small audio pentode — European hi-fi.

EL83.notes: TV audio output pentode — similar to EL84 but lower ratings.

EL84.notes: Vox/Marshall 18W SE ~5W — the classic small power pentode. Voxy V2p ideal.

EL86.notes: Low-Va sibling of EL84 — TV vertical output.

EL90.notes: 6AQ5 — 7-pin baby 6V6. Small power pentode, drop-in for Voxy socket.

KT88.notes: Big beam — overkill for 4W SE, and octal.

PCL86.notes: Voxy V2 output tube. 13V heater triode+SE pentode in one 9-pin envelope.

ZM1000.notes: Nixie tube — glow-discharge decimal digit display.
